source.title: REDOUANE BOUGHERABA - J'AI CONTRÔLÉ LES CONTRÔLEURS (impro, « On m'appelle Marseille », Théâtre de Dix Heures)

rights.notes: Requested by the channel owner (2026-11-12). Credit Redouane Bougheraba and link the original.

context_note: Opening of the improv: he learns the front rows are SNCF/RATP ticket inspectors, the 'lapsus', the strikes, inspectors who wait until you fall asleep, the TV ad with plain-clothes inspectors. Stops BEFORE the 2:42–3:21 exchange about racism, which needs the full context.
